examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A section heading that links to itself. Hover or focus it to see the underline and the link glyph; neither takes layout.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DocHeading from '@aziontech/webkit/doc-heading'
</script>

<template>
  <DocHeading
    id="purge-by-url"
    :level="2"
  >
    Purge by URL
  </DocHeading>
</template>
